name: Konoe Sunao
source:
Sunao is a second year student from class 2-A and the head of the drama club. [spoiler]Incidentally, she was [url=/c60]Leo's[/url] classmate at junior high school.[/spoiler] Sunao has a strong sense of justice. She hates Erika Kiriya who is self-righteous. At beginning of the story, she has a poor attitude towards Leo, and she is hard for him to deal with. Her story was added in the PS2 version. The Minikiss for PC contains her story added sexual content with her path on the PS2 version.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsuyokiss]Wikipedia[/url]]
